items.label: Power Solutions International Q2 FY2026 (08-06-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Q2 2026 net sales were $152.5 million, a decrease of $39.4 million

set.signal: Q2 2026 net sales were $152.5 million, a decrease of $39.4 million, or 21%, versus Q2 2025, and up 18.6% from Q1 2026 (above the prior expectation that Q2 would be generally consistent with Q1). The year-over-year decrease was driven by $34.6 million lower sales in the power systems end markets, $3.7 million in industrial and $1.7 million in transportation; within power systems the decline primarily reflects uneven order patterns and shipment timing for data center-related products, together with continued softness in oil and gas. Interim CEO/CFO Ken Li: most of the sequential increase came from power systems, as the Wisconsin operation increased production and sales. The $3.7 million industrial decrease is as spoken on the call; the filed earnings release (8-K Exhibit 99.1) prints a different industrial figure (see the Power Solutions International 8-K entry).

items.reason: Board question 'Power Solutions International' (Claude decision 2026-10-19, user delegated): keep the call entry as its own source states and flag the filed figure, as in edgar_r3_call_figure_fixes; the entry's revenue_growth slot ($152.5 million) is unaffected.
items.evidence: 8-K EX-99.1: 'The decrease reflected lower sales of $34.6 million, $3.0 million and $1.7 million in the power systems, industrial and transportation end markets, respectively.'
